Scrollspy watches a set of sections and which one is currently in view. The table of contents on the right of every documentation page is the live demo: the matching link gets active and aria-current="true". Clicking a link is a normal hash jump — the offset is scroll-margin, the motion is scroll-behavior: smooth.

Put scrollspy and an id on each section. In the TOC, use table-of-contents and point each link at #that-id. AutoInit() starts every .scrollspy except those marked no-autoinit. Observation is IntersectionObserver — there is no scroll listener.

The IIFE bundle exposes Expressive.ScrollSpy. Call init yourself when you need options other than the defaults, or let Expressive.AutoInit() start every .scrollspy.

{% call code() %} document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { const elems = document.querySelectorAll('.scrollspy'); const instances = Expressive.ScrollSpy.init(elems, { // specify options here }); }); {% endcall %}

Per-instance options can also be passed through AutoInit:

{% call code() %} Expressive.AutoInit(document.body, { ScrollSpy: { scrollOffset: 200 } }); {% endcall %}

The documentation TOC is position: sticky. Scrollspy only updates which link is active.

{% endcall %} {% call section("options", "Options") %} {% call options_table() %} scrollOffset Number 200 Offset in pixels. Written as --md-comp-scrollspy-offset (section scroll-margin) and used as the observer rootMargin. activeClass String 'active' Class applied to the active table-of-contents link. getActiveElement Function see below Optional. Returns a CSS selector for the element that should receive activeClass, given the section’s id. The default finds a[href="#id"] by comparing attributes — it does not interpolate the id into a selector. keepTopElementActive Boolean false If true, keep the last section above the viewport active when nothing intersects. If there is no such section, the first one stays active. {% endcall %}
getActiveElement

Only needed when the TOC is not a[href="#id"]. Return a CSS selector. Escape any author-controlled id yourself.

{% call code() %} function(id) { return '[data-section="' + CSS.escape(id) + '"]'; } {% endcall %} {% endcall %} {% call section("methods", "Methods") %} {{ instance_note("ScrollSpy") }}
.destroy();
